Definition: neuter of the same as G1636; olive oil:--oil.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, élaion is the word for oil. In Matthew 25:3, the text says "and took no oil with them." In Mark 6:13, the text says "and anointed with oil many that were sick."
TheologicalSignificance: What élaion teaches me is that creation is God's handiwork, and it still speaks of Him to anyone willing to look. That shapes how I read the passages where it appears: not as filler, but as God's own wording for what He is doing.
RelatedEvents: Jesus Sends Out the Twelve; The Sinful Woman Anoints Jesus; The Wise and Foolish Virgins
